# plan 2026-10-01-nccl-curve
# local results -> /runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve
# [sync] mkdir node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
mkdir -p "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench" "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve"
LAB_EOF
# [sync] copy bench scripts to node0
scp -q /src/tools/lab/remote/collective_bench.py /src/tools/lab/remote/probe_env.py node0:inference-sim-lab/bench/
# [sync] mkdir node1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
mkdir -p "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench" "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve"
LAB_EOF
# [sync] copy bench scripts to node1
scp -q /src/tools/lab/remote/collective_bench.py /src/tools/lab/remote/probe_env.py node1:inference-sim-lab/bench/
# [clean] stop stale processes on node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[c]ollective_bench.py' || true
LAB_EOF
# [clean] stop stale processes on node1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[c]ollective_bench.py' || true
LAB_EOF
# [preflight] probe node0 -> probe-node0.json
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/probe_env.py"
LAB_EOF
# [preflight] probe node1 -> probe-node1.json
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/probe_env.py"
LAB_EOF
# [launch] start rank 0 on node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
cd "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve" || exit 1
nohup env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" MASTER_ADDR="10.1.1.69" MASTER_PORT="29500" RANK="0" WORLD_SIZE="2" LOCAL_RANK="0" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/collective_bench.py" --min-bytes 1024 --max-bytes 268435456 --iters 30 --warmup 5 --ops all_reduce,all_gather,reduce_scatter,all_to_all,send_recv --sim-node-id 0 --output "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_curve.jsonl" > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_rank0.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
LAB_EOF
# [launch] start rank 1 on node1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
cd "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve" || exit 1
nohup env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" MASTER_ADDR="10.1.1.69" MASTER_PORT="29500" RANK="1" WORLD_SIZE="2" LOCAL_RANK="0" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/collective_bench.py" --min-bytes 1024 --max-bytes 268435456 --iters 30 --warmup 5 --ops all_reduce,all_gather,reduce_scatter,all_to_all,send_recv --sim-node-id 1 --output "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_curve.jsonl" > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_rank1.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
LAB_EOF
# [wait] collective results (poll until complete=1, expected=114, timeout=3600s)
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
n=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.collective.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_curve.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); d=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.done.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_curve.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); if pgrep -f '[c]ollective_bench.py.*2026-10-01-nccl-curve' >/dev/null; then a=1; else a=0; fi; if [ "${d:-0}" -ge 1 ] && [ "${n:-0}" -ge 114 ]; then c=1; else c=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=${n:-0} alive=$a"
LAB_EOF
# [collect] collect collective_curve.jsonl
scp -q node0:inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_curve.jsonl /runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_curve.jsonl
# [collect] collect collective_rank0.log
scp -q node0:inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_rank0.log /runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_rank0.log
# [collect] collect collective_rank1.log
scp -q node1:inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_rank1.log /runs/2026-10-01-nccl-curve/collective_rank1.log
# [teardown] stop stale processes on node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[c]ollective_bench.py' || true
LAB_EOF
# [teardown] stop stale processes on node1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[c]ollective_bench.py' || true
LAB_EOF
